issues.description: The problem statement and the template require Developer.attend(course:) to accept an optional Course (Course?). However, the solution implementation declares attend(course:) with a non-optional Course parameter. This mismatch in the method parameter type (optional vs non-optional) can confuse students about the intended behavior (the instructions explicitly ask for optional binding) and may cause discrepancies when running tests that pass nil to attend(_:).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution's attend(course:) signature match the problem and template by accepting an optional Course (func attend(course: Course?)). Update the implementation to use optional binding (if let course = course) before checking the course name and updating monthsOfSwiftExperience, so nil inputs are safely handled and behavior matches the exercise instructions.
